definitions.content:
Chapter 9.1, Hydrometer Test Method for Density, Relative Density (Specific Gravity), or API Gravity of Crude Petroleum and Liquid Petroleum Products, First Edition, June 1981 (ANSI/ASTM D 1298)

This chapter describes the methods and practices relating to the determination of the density, relative density, or API gravity of crude petroleum and liquid petroleum products using the hydrometer method (laboratory determination). 5 pages.

Price each, $4.00
